app.title: VocaSight Kids
app.disclaimer: Friendly Practice Companion • Not a Medical or Diagnostic Tool

welcome.heroSubtitle: Explore magical speech worlds with your AI Speech Buddy, Magic Mouth Mirror, and animal friends!
welcome.privacyDetails: Your child's voice and webcam video are processed in memory inside your browser and never uploaded to any server.
welcome.medicalNote: Notice: VocaSight Kids is designed for fun practice and motivation. It is not a diagnostic tool and does not replace speech-language therapy.
welcome.parentalConsentDesc: To enable the Magic Mouth Mirror and voice check, VocaSight Kids requests camera and microphone access. All video and audio remain strictly on this device and are discarded after each practice attempt.
welcome.consentCheckbox: I am a parent or guardian and agree to camera & microphone usage for offline speech practice.
